title: Cloudflare plan approval binding
$comment: Public file platform/access/cloudflare-approval.yaml. A merged PR carrying this binding approves exactly one exposure state (byte-identical services/exposures.yaml at the bound revision and HEAD) and one plan digest; the connectivity reconciler applies that plan with no second operator command. Merging the approval PR keeps the exposure bytes identical, so the approval stays satisfiable; stale or mismatched bindings never apply.
